description: HW7 Part 2/3 fixed verification tasks. Each one needs at least two tool calls and is asked once, with no follow-up prompting. Expected values are checked against MySQL s9486_rel at verification time, not hard-coded.

A.name: search then detail lookup
A.prompt: Search for listings in Campbell, then look up the full details of the first result and tell me its listing code, title and landlord name.

B.name: aggregate then supporting example
B.prompt: How many listings does landlord 12 manage, and how many units are available in total? Then back it up with one example: search listings in San Jose and give me the listing code of one listing that belongs to landlord 12.

C.name: compare two entities (search + two detail lookups)
C.prompt: Search for listings with parking and compare the first two results: look up the details of both and tell me each one's listing code, address and landlord name.

error_recovery.name: nonexistent id
error_recovery.prompt: Give me the full details for listing LST-99999.
